A DIFFERENT POINT OF DEPARTURE

Same world.
A perspective
closer to home.

A beautiful destination is only half the picture. The other half is knowing what to sort out before you leave Canada.

01 / ENTRY

Start with your passport.

Find the official entry and exit requirements for your destination. Check the rules for your passport, trip purpose and length of stay.

02 / EVERYDAY LIFE

Think beyond the plane ticket.

Make a plan for your budget in Canadian dollars, card fees, mobile data and the first journey from the airport.

03 / BACK HOME

Leave with the loose ends tied.

Review your insurance, keep access to your accounts, and leave someone at home with the details they might need.
